benefits_features_and_faqs.about_overview: The Paytm AU Credit Card, offered in partnership between Paytm and AU Small Finance Bank, is a lifetime-free card that rewards everyday UPI, Paytm Gold and travel spends made through the Paytm app. Read on to know about the features and benefits of this card, followed by a detailed review.
highlights: 5 reward points per Rs. 100 spent on Paytm Travel and Paytm Gold
1 reward point per Rs. 100 spent on utility bills paid via the Paytm App
2 reward points per Rs. 100 spent on Paytm UPI transactions worth Rs. 100 to Rs. 2,000
milestone_benefits: 1 reward point per Rs. 100 spent on all eligible online and offline spends
1% fuel surcharge waiver, up to Rs. 100 per month, on fuel transactions between Rs. 400 and Rs. 4,000
movie_benefits: 12 complimentary domestic airport lounge visits in a year for booking flight tickets through the Paytm App
Lounge visits are tied to the condition of booking return tickets via Paytm Travel
get_this_card_if: You make most of your UPI spends via Paytm App
You prefer making travel bookings through the Paytm App
You do not have a card that rewards utility bill payments
You need lounge access without any monthly or quarterly capping

faqs.q: Is the Paytm AU Credit Card lifetime free?
faqs.a: Yes, the card does not carry any joining or annual fee.

faqs.q: What are the benefits of the Paytm AU Credit Card?
faqs.a: Paytm AU Credit Card offers up to 5% value-back on Paytm Travel bookings and up to 2% value-back on Paytm UPI payments as reward points. It also offers up to 12 complimentary domestic lounge visits every year.

faqs.q: Does the Paytm AU Credit Card offer rewards on UPI payments made through other apps?
faqs.a: Yes, you will get rewards on UPI spends made through other apps but at a much lower rate of 1 reward point for every Rs. 400 spent.

faqs.q: How can I redeem Paytm AU Credit Card reward points?
faqs.a: You can redeem the reward points earned on the Paytm AU Credit Card through the AU Rewardz portal where 1 reward point = Rs. 0.5. However, if you redeem them against Paytm Gold purchase, you get 1:1 redemption value.

faqs.q: Is the Paytm AU Credit Card good for everyday UPI spends?
faqs.a: Yes, if you prefer Paytm for all your UPI spends, this credit card can be a good choice.

pros_and_cons.editorial_summary: Lifetime Free option from AU Small Finance Bank suited for travel & miles users with 12 domestic lounge visits/yr.
pros: Accelerated rewards on travel bookings made via Paytm Travel
Good value-back on UPI transactions made via Paytm App
Utility bill payments are not excluded and earn rewards when made via Paytm App
Up to 12 free domestic lounge visits in a year
1:1 reward redemption value against Paytm Gold
cons: Lounge visits are tied to the condition of booking return tickets via Paytm Travel
Low reward rate on transactions beyond Paytm App, and even lower value on making UPI transactions through other apps
Lower reward redemption value when redeeming through the AU Rewardz Platform
pros_and_cons.best_for_whom: Domestic & international flyers value-optimizing airline/hotel loyalty points and lounge access
pros_and_cons.not_ideal_for: Low-travel users preferring straight monthly statement cashback
pros_and_cons.verdict: Lifetime Free option from AU Small Finance Bank suited for travel & miles users with 12 domestic lounge visits/yr.

reddit_user_feedback.sentiment_summary: Community discussions around AU Small Finance Bank Travel & Miles cards.
practical_community_warnings: High 3.5% (+GST) forex markup makes international swipes net negative.
Quarterly spend thresholds for domestic airport lounge access
Exclusion of rent, wallet, utilities, education, and government spends from reward points
Conservative monthly cap estimate (Rs. 1,000-1,500/mo) applied on accelerated categories pending explicit issuer cap verification.
optimization_tips: Focus spends on flights & hotel bookings (5.0% effective return) before hitting monthly category caps.
Avoid foreign currency & international SaaS charges on this card due to 3.5% + GST forex markup; use a 0%-forex card instead.
Check spend criteria and pre-generate terminal QR access via official portals (LoungeOne.ai / TFS / HOI) before arriving at the airport.
